text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.

WHEAT SALE - South Korean feed milling companies bought 25,500 tonnes of Chinese corn at $141.60 a tonne C&F from Haitai International Inc and 34,000 tonnes at $139.90 a tonne C&F from Daewoo Corp, traders said. Traders said arrival for 25,500 tonnes was slated for May 20 and 30 to the port of Kunsan, while 34,000 tonnes were set for May 20 to Inchon.

WHEAT SALE - The European Union will provide 25,000 tonnes of Danish wheat and 20,000 tonnes of British wheat as food aid to Bangladesh for shipment this month, a European Commission official said. The official declined to give further information ahead of publication of the food aid tender result in the EU Official Journal, expected on Tuesday.

- South Korean feed milling companies bought 50,000 tonnes of Canadian wheat at $145 a tonne C&F. Japanese trading house Nissho Iwai Corp sold the wheat last week through private negotiations with shipment due June 5-25. Arrival was set for July 10 at the port of Inchon.
WHEAT TENDER - Algeria has launched a tender for the purchase of 75,000 tonnes of French, Argentine or U.S. soft wheat or any combination of the three, European grain traders said on Monday.

... Japan will re-tender for 20,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat and 20,000 of Canadian barley on March 6. The agency bought 180,000 tonnes of wheat and 60,000 of barley on Thursday. But it failed to purchase 20,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat and 20,000 of Canadian barley due to price.

WHEAT TENDER - Slovenia on Wednesday will seek a total of 30,000 tonnes optional origin milling quality wheat, several U.S. exporters said. The estimated arrival date in Slovenia was April 12 and the tender was believed to be private, one exporter said. No other details were available.

- Peru will tender on Tuesday for between 20,000 and 25,000 tonnes of optional origin durum, several U.S. exporters said. One exporter said he believed the durum to be of U.S. origin. Shipment date was slated for March 15-April 15. Estimated date of arrival was April 30, another exporter said. No other details were available.

CORN, SOY AND WHEAT TENDER - High international prices mean Taiwanese buyers are likely to be lukewarm participants in grain and oilseed markets this week, traders said. One tender for 54,000 tonnes of soybeans and corn and two shipments totalling 69,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat for the Taiwan Flour Mills Association are scheduled in the next few days.

MARKET TALK - The French port of Nantes was due to start loading wheat for Iraq on Monday under a major program of French wheat sales to help relieve the plight of Iraqis hit by international sanctions, freight sources said.
... South Korea bought at least 544,500 tonnes of grains and oilseeds during February through tenders and private negotiations, traders said.
